Modi Cabinet Reshuffle Rumored Ahead of Monsoon Session

Speculation is rife regarding a potential reshuffle of the Union Cabinet, with reports suggesting significant changes and the possible exclusion of prominent figures. These discussions are occurring across social media and within political circles. The reshuffle is anticipated to take place before the monsoon session of Parliament, which is expected to commence around July 20.
